capabilities: Toggle squiggle text rendering on or off globally via command palette, ribbon or status bar
Set a hotkey for toggling scribble mode
Apply squiggle rendering to single notes through the cssclasses property
Keep note title, properties, word count, cursor and selection readable and functional while squiggles are on
disambiguation: Not a drawing or handwriting tool; it only disguises note text with a squiggle font while writing.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian always shows your text as readable, which tempts you to fix and polish words while you should still be drafting.

relations.evidence: Inspired by the scribble font in Ellipsus.
Scribble Mode uses Redacted Script by Christian Naths, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

summary: Writing mode that renders note text as unreadable squiggles so you can draft without stopping to reread or edit.
